item.text:
Subject: Request to Combine Deliveries

Dear [Supplier Name],

I hope you are well. We have two orders currently scheduled for delivery: [Order Number 1] and [Order Number 2]. Would it be possible to combine them into a single delivery, provided this fits your schedule and handling requirements?

Please let us know whether this can be arranged, along with any implications for timing, packaging, or delivery arrangements. We understand that combining deliveries may not affect pricing.

Thank you for your assistance.

Kind regards,  
[Your Name]
